name: Mogons

attributes.attribute: name means to increase, a god of strength and fertility
an epithet of Vitiris at Netherby

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Mogons, also called Mogounos, is a Continental Celtic god. The name may come from a word that means to increase, so he reads as a deity of strength and fertility. In Roman Britain Mogons appears as an epithet of the god Vitiris on a stone from Castra Exploratorum at Netherby, close to the west end of Hadrian's Wall. An independent deity of the same name is known at Voreda, the old Penrith in Cumbria. The name is an old form that sits with the word for great, the same stem behind the place-name Mogontiacum, the city that is now Mainz on the Rhine.
objective: Document Mogons, the god of strength and fertility.
